note: Batch version of GET /profile. At most 20 items. Each profile has the exact shape of contracts/credit/profile.json. A failed item goes to errors and does not fail the batch.

errors.INVALID_NETWORK: 422, network is not mainnet, testnet or devnet
errors.ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: 404, the account does not exist on that network
errors.UPSTREAM_ERROR: 502, the XRPL endpoint failed after retries
